items.name: AC-DC meshed (PyPSA example)
items.description: Small synthetic 9-bus meshed AC/DC test network (UK, Germany, Norway nodes) shipped with PyPSA: 7 AC lines, 4 DC links, 6 generators (gas/wind, extendable), 10 hourly snapshots starting 2015-01-01. Illustrative only; not a real grid.

license.attribution: AC-DC meshed example network, (c) PyPSA Contributors, CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/PyPSA/PyPSA (examples/networks/ac-dc-meshed).

items.name: IEEE 118-bus (PGLib-OPF v23.07)
items.description: IEEE 118-bus test case (AEP system, 1962) as curated in PGLib-OPF v23.07 'typical operations' benchmark: 118 buses, 186 branches, 54 generators, single operating point.

license.attribution: PGLib-OPF v23.07 (c) IEEE PES Task Force on Benchmarks for Validation of Emerging Power System Algorithms, CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/power-grid-lib/pglib-opf; IEEE 118-bus data (c) 1999 Richard D. Christie, University of Washington (CC-BY-4.0).

items.name: IEEE 14-bus (PGLib-OPF v23.07)
items.description: IEEE 14-bus test case (1962 AEP system) as curated in PGLib-OPF v23.07 'typical operations' benchmark: 14 buses, 20 branches, 5 generators, single operating point.

license.attribution: PGLib-OPF v23.07 (c) IEEE PES Task Force on Benchmarks for Validation of Emerging Power System Algorithms, CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/power-grid-lib/pglib-opf; IEEE 14-bus data (c) 1999 Richard D. Christie, University of Washington (CC-BY-4.0).

items.name: SciGRID Germany (PyPSA example)
items.description: German 220/380 kV transmission grid from SciGRID v0.2 (derived from OpenStreetMap), with power plants, load and renewable availability for 24 hourly snapshots of 2011-01-01, as packaged by the PyPSA project (pypsa.examples.scigrid_de).

license.attribution: SciGRID Germany example network, (c) PyPSA Contributors (CC-BY-4.0, https://github.com/PyPSA/PyPSA); grid topology from SciGRID v0.2 (DLR Institute of Networked Energy Systems, formerly NEXT ENERGY, www.scigrid.de) based on OpenStreetMap data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0.
